features.title: Multi-format chat parser
features.behavior: preprocessor.preprocess() parses Android 24h, Android 12h AM/PM, and iOS export formats into a normalized DataFrame (user, message, date + derived columns); system messages map to 'group_notification'
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_preprocessor.py: 7 passed (all 3 formats parse, multiline join, ValueError, derived columns)

features.title: Format-aware media-marker handling
features.behavior: Media/system-marker rows are detected across formats (Android '<Media omitted>', iOS '<Media omitted>' variants and omitted-message lines) and excluded from word/emoji analytics while counted in stats
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_helper.py: media counts 3 (android_24h) and 3 (ios_export); 'omitted' excluded from common words

features.title: emoji v2 compatibility
features.behavior: emoji_helper() extracts emojis using the emoji v2 API (emoji.emoji_list / EMOJI_DATA), working on emoji>=2.0

features.title: PII redaction toggle (default ON)
features.behavior: app.py sidebar exposes a redaction checkbox defaulting to ON; when enabled, phone numbers, emails, and URLs are masked in messages before any analysis or display
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_redaction.py: 6 passed; app.py checkbox value=True

features.title: Cached preprocessing
features.behavior: app.py wraps preprocessing in @st.cache_data so re-runs do not re-parse the upload
features.evidence: grep @st.cache_data app.py OK; full suite green

features.title: Pinned dependencies + Heroku removal
features.behavior: requirements.txt pins exact versions; Procfile and setup.sh removed
features.verification: test ! -f Procfile && test ! -f setup.sh && grep -c '==' requirements.txt
features.evidence: Procfile/setup.sh absent; requirements.txt has 8 exact pins

features.title: Synthetic fixtures
features.behavior: tests/fixtures contains synthetic Android 24h, Android 12h AM/PM, and iOS chat exports covering users, system messages, media markers, links, emojis, and PII

features.title: Harness onboarding
features.behavior: Project has AGENTS.md, init.sh, feature_list.json, progress.md, DECISIONS.md, FLOW.md; init.sh runs baseline verification from scratch
features.evidence: AGENTS.md, init.sh, feature_list.json, progress.md, DECISIONS.md, FLOW.md, pytest.ini present; ./init.sh run below
